correctness.rationale: For all subsets X, box commutation is precisely equality of R∘R^{-1} and R^{-1}∘R. For t distinct off-diagonal no-common-neighbor events, a fixed outsider supplies each forbidden witness with probability p_n²; pairwise witness intersections cost O_t(p_n³). The inside-endpoint arc correction is 1+O_t(p_n²). Thus intersections equal n^{-2t}e^{-tc}(1+o(1)), uniformly; factorial moments converge to e^{-tc} and yield Poisson(e^{-c}). A union bound on zero in-/outdegrees makes diagonal mismatches o(1). Python exhaustive graph enumeration through n=4 separately confirms relation/valuation equivalence and finite first moments; finite tests are not substituted for proof.
